fund_approve.text:
FUNDING STEP 1 OF 2 (approve). Nothing has been signed or sent; PayBox will show the raw call and ask before anything moves.
Proposal: approve exactly 3 USDC (Circle USDC on Base) for the Hyperlane warp router. Value 0. Expires 2030-01-01T00:04:00Z.
XO smart account (derived from owner 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266): 0xB3729F7e1Ab0B4a50E7De5599Ecc321B8775d30d (relay state: registered).
Relay reservation: funding_id 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, 3 USD reserved until 2030-01-01T00:05:00Z.
Next: when PayBox shows this request succeeded, call xo_fund_account again with the same owner and amount_usd. It returns step 2 (the transfer). Keep funding_id 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef and xo_balance_before_usd 0.
Send this request from the PayBox wallet 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266: PayBox does not tell this plugin which wallet signs, and the allowance and balance above were read for that address. It also needs a little ETH on Base for gas.
Warning: Only the Base side of the route was verified; the XO side was not read.
Warning: Funding is one-way until an exit is proven: there is no verified withdrawal path (test T4).
The per-order and daily caps are enforced by this plugin and its relay only. They are advisory against a compromised or prompt-injected agent, which can ask PayBox to sign directly and bypass them.
Use a dedicated PayBox credential as the XO owner and put only what you can afford to lose behind it: one approval of an opaque digest can also move that wallet's funds elsewhere.
